prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a tense moment at a beach volleyball tournament under bright sunlight. On the left, a woman in a blue bikini stands ready with knees bent, her eyes fixed on the ball. In the center, a man in yellow shorts leaps high into the air, his arm extended to spike the white volleyball. To the right, a referee in a striped shirt watches intently, holding a whistle near his mouth. Behind the net, a spectator in a wide-brimmed hat sits on a folding chair, shading their face from the sun. Next to the spectator, a golden retriever lies calmly on the sand, tongue lolling out. In the foreground, a cooler with condensation droplets sits partially buried in the sand. The woman in the blue bikini is looking at the man in yellow shorts as he prepares to strike. The golden retriever is sitting next to the spectator in the wide-brimmed hat. The man in yellow shorts is jumping above the net. The referee in the striped shirt is standing behind the net. There is no scoreboard visible in the background.
